fusions.name: Wrung Dry
fusions.desc: Seizes an enemy in a mailed grip and squeezes, dealing 16 damage and using up every affliction you have on it for 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Knuckle Rap
fusions.desc: Raps an enemy with mailed knuckles, dealing 5 damage, leaving it 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds and with a 50% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Hold the Line
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds, you take 20% less damage.

fusions.name: Gauntlet That Fits
fusions.desc: Conjures a fitted iron gauntlet: your armour rises by 8%, your critical chance rises by 4%, your critical hits deal 0.1x more, and each kill returns 3 health.
